text.description_html:
Deltana FPG610B, Oil Rubbed Bronze Finish Solid Brass 6" Offset Surface Bolt

This Deltana 6 Inch Offset Surface Door Bolt is made of solid brass. It can be installed horizontally or vertically on the surface of almost any door. The guides on this heavy duty door bolt are held in place with a unique ball bearing system that eliminates scratches on the barrel of the bolt, hold tension on the bolt and prevents rattling of the guides. Please see our guide on the uses of surface bolts. Package includes 6 inch surface bolt, mortise strike plate, universal strike plate, angle strike plate, 2 bolt guides and matching oval phillips head finish brass wood screws. Available in an oil rubbed bronze finish.

Also Available:
10" Offset Surface Bolt - 18" Offset Surface Bolt - 26" Offset Surface Bolt - 42" Offset Surface Bolt

Specifications for the Deltana FPG610B 6 Inch Offset Surface Bolt:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Bolt Length: 6"
  • Bolt Width: 5/8" Diameter Half Round Rod
  • Bolt Offset: 5/8"
  • Guide Width: 1-1/2"
  • Guide Projection: 9/16"
  • Knob Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Knob Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Bolt Throw: 1-1/16"
  • Rod Resistance: 109 lbs.
  • Includes 3 Strike Plates
  • Packaged with all mounting hardware
  • Wood Screws: oval phillips head #6 x 1-1/4"
  • Deltana FPG6 6 Inch Surface Bolt Dimensions (PDF)
